Status binding, exclusive selected HID route/fallback/profile behavior; stale quiet disable/activity interleavings, splash uptime wrap and new tuple publication during old expiry; test_quiet_setter_ordering preserves a newer positive timeout and finite timer after an older zero-timeout setter resumes
Initial values, clamps, invalid/read failures, unrelated-event isolation; actual callbacks with controlled registry/pthread kernel stand-ins preserve newer values across an older paused read
Optional public getter and invalidation adapter
Exact numeric tuple forwarding and unrelated-event isolation
Actual production preprocessor selector under 20 independent status/chosen rotation metadata combinations
Public full runner rejects empty/unrelated synthetic gcov without real compiler execution; each gated range requires measured lines; complete and missed line/branch parsing

Actual public shell freshness, output mount, command exits and retained owner/graph/compiler evidence; optional repository-scoped read-only deploy-key mounts and missing-key rejection. Recording Docker/west tools only, no firmware or authenticated fetch.

Actual Zephyr kernel/workqueue behavior with a recording display including quiet decision races, positive timeout re-enable while old disable handler runs, and LED tuple republish during paused expiry when enabled; existing runtime/blank/external-port assertions retained; same ELF repeated three times per configuration

limits: Host function extraction and controlled registry/workqueue/tool stand-ins do not prove real scheduling, persistent storage, I2C deadlines or radio/physical behavior; native and unchanged stock/DYA compile variants remain separate.

execution.default: quick: every host behavioral fixture/scenario under ASan/UBSan once; validator/process units once; native kernel fixtures use the separate integration entry
execution.full: ZMK_TEST_MODE=full: same host scenarios plus optimized and measured coverage variants; kernel/supported-core compilation uses separate integration entry
execution.integration: owner native/DTS/API guards when interfaces or kernel contracts change; not a prerequisite for pure host behavior
execution.transport: actual ordered USB/BLE/split/power/reset evidence; archived simulation is not a passing substitute
